text: All over the world, people save in rotating circles: a chit fund, a tanda, a susu.
tts: All over the world, people save in rotating circles. A chit fund, a tanda, a soosoo.

text: Everyone pays the same amount each round, and one member takes the whole pot, in turn.
tts: Everyone pays the same amount each round, and one member takes the whole pot, in turn.

text: It runs on trust. Whoever takes the pot early can stop paying, and the others lose.
tts: It runs on trust. Whoever takes the pot early can stop paying. And the others lose.

text: Kitty puts these circles on NEAR, and lets a community's DAO stand behind its members.
tts: Kitty puts these circles on near, and lets a community's DAO stand behind its members.

text: This is Banyan Co-op, a Sputnik DAO, live on testnet. Its council voted once on Kitty's terms.
tts: This is Banyan Co-op, a Sputnik DAO, live on testnet. Its council voted once, on Kitty's terms.

text: A member's credit is what they paid on time in circles they finished, and the DAO caps it.
tts: A member's credit is what they paid on time, in circles they finished. And the DAO caps it.

text: Priya starts a circle for December rent, with Ama, Tomás and Lin. A tenth of a NEAR a round.
tts: Priya starts a circle for December rent, with Ama, Tomas, and Lin. A tenth of a near, a round.

text: Each seat shows what that member gets in their turn. Priya finished a circle before, so she can take the full pot first.
tts: Each seat shows what that member gets in their turn. Priya finished a circle before, so she can take the full pot, first.

text: Ama is new. She gets her own money now, and the rest is held back for her later dues. Nobody in the circle can lose.
tts: Ama is new. She gets her own money now, and the rest is held back, for her later dues. Nobody in the circle can lose.

text: Everyone takes their seat, and round one is paid.
tts: Everyone takes their seat, and round one is paid.

text: Priya takes the whole pot: 0.4 NEAR, three quarters of it on credit.
tts: Priya takes the whole pot. Zero point four near, three quarters of it on credit.

text: Every step is a post in the circle's NEAR Social thread, written by the contract. Mentions notify each member when their dues are due.
tts: Every step is a post in the circle's near social thread, written by the contract. Mentions notify each member, when their dues are due.

text: Round two goes to Ama: half now, half held back.
tts: Round two goes to Ama. Half now, half held back.

text: In round three, Priya doesn't pay. The deadline passes.
tts: In round three, Priya doesn't pay. The deadline passes.

text: Kitty files an ordinary proposal on the DAO for exactly the missing dues, and passes it with the one vote the council gave it for small covers.
tts: Kitty files an ordinary proposal on the DAO, for exactly the missing dues. And passes it with the one vote the council gave it, for small covers.

text: And Tomás still gets the full pot.
tts: And Tomas, still gets the full pot.

text: Priya now owes the DAO, and her credit is zero until she repays.
tts: Priya now owes the DAO. And her credit is zero, until she repays.

text: She repays, and her credit is back. Every line of her record is on chain.
tts: She repays, and her credit is back. Every line of her record is on chain.

text: Lin takes the last pot. The circle is complete, and everyone who paid on time has a bigger record.
tts: Lin takes the last pot. The circle is complete. And everyone who paid on time, has a bigger record.

text: Larger covers wait for the council, like any proposal. The treasury never leaves the DAO.
tts: Larger covers wait for the council, like any proposal. The treasury never leaves the DAO.

text: Kitty. Savings circles your community stands behind.
tts: Kitty. Savings circles your community stands behind.
